answers.core: It modifies the inspector, and makes curves usable for more complex and precise tasks. The fact that it is not already built into the engine is very odd.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around at runtime using the set_point_position(), set_point_in(), and set_point_out() methods, but cannot be worked around in the editor.

title: Specify exact values for Curve Control Points in the Inspector
